name: Partons à Cheval Trouver les Licornes !
detailed_description:
This new game developed by the audacious, charismatic, sensational, breathtaking, agile, wonderful, reckless, fantastic and single Capucine Mahieux seriously promises to revolutionize the History of pony games in its entirety, thus creating a before and after of an absolutely insane magnitude.

Go in this Point and Click Visual Novel of horse riding in search of unicorns in the charming town of Saint Amand les Eaux!!!!

Unfortunately, your belongings were lost during the trip.. that's where THE PONY comes in!!!!!!

Take care of your equine friend, train him and participate in competitions in order to restock your money and equipment.

Several inhabitants are to be met in Saint Amand les Eaux, including very handsome and attractive boys OMG. O_O

INITIAL GOAL:

You're heading to Saint Amand Les Eaux to find a real unicorn !

To do this, you'll need to unlock items and areas, purchase the equipment your pony needs for your two-person expeditions, as well as research materials.

ECONOMY:

There are many different ways to earn in-game currency: "money" !

Of course, you can participate in competitions, but you can also help the locals or collect items by playing mini-games.

In short, another system that revolves around money.

COLLECTIONS:

You can challenge yourself to find every type of dropping, every fishing loot, every fruit, every animal photo, every area, or even every sticker.

There are several rankings for these finds, ranging from "common" to "legendary" or even "extra legendary."

HORSES AND RIDING:

Like all self-respecting horse riding games, you'll of course have basic riding tasks to perform. Like grooming your companion before mounting him for a ride. This is important, as you need your pony to travel the map.

For numbers fans, there's also a statistics system, which determines your pony's score in competitions, which influences the amount of money you win.

However, just as your equine friend is loyal to you, you remain loyal !

You don't ride any other mounts. That said, you can collect the presence of other characters' horses on the ranch and groom them.

RESIDENTS:

You might scare off more than one of them with your shifty appearance and questionable hygiene. Their reactions can be a bit strong, but rest assured, there are solutions!

A tie, for example, will be enough to allay the municipal employee's fears.

As in many games, here too, these idiots will need your help to solve problems they don't know how to handle themselves.

But above all, the residents will be there to help you progress in your game, by selling the items you need in their shops, for example. ( Wow, that's a super innovative concept, right ? )

Plus, they're visually very pleasant residents. Muscular men with skimpy clothes, colorful hair, cat ears, and even visible chest hair await you !

" Can we develop relationships with the characters ? " you ask ? We'll see. Calm down, my dear. I'm not at that stage of development yet.

        ------------------

"A true French masterpiece"

- Someone

"If there is one thing in this world that needs to be preserved, it is neither biodiversity, nor values, nor even oxygen, but rather the works of this insanely talented developer."

- A guy in my cellar
